item.content:encoded:
£30,000 Basic Salary | First Year OTE £48,500 | Southampton Based
We are looking for confident, driven and enthusiastic Telemarketers to join our growing sales team at F One Technologies.
This is a telephone based sales role focused on contacting UK business owners, introducing them to F One, and booking quality appointments for our field sales team. You will be speaking with decision makers, identifying opportunities, and arranging meetings for our consultants to discuss how we can support their business.
F One Technologies is a telecommunications and technology provider based in Southampton. We support UK businesses with cloud phone systems, internet connectivity, WiFi and networking, business mobile solutions, IT services, cybersecurity, and related communication tools. This gives our telemarketing team a strong range of relevant services to talk about, rather than being limited to one product or one narrow campaign.
What the role involves
As a Telemarketer, you will be contacting businesses over the phone and introducing them to the services we provide. The aim is to create interest, ask the right questions, and book appointments for our field sales team to meet with business owners and decision makers.
You will be expected to build rapport quickly, explain the value of what we offer in a clear and professional way, and maintain accurate notes and appointment details within our CRM system.
This role would suit people who enjoy speaking to others, are comfortable working to targets, and want to be rewarded properly for strong performance.
Earnings and progression
We offer a £30,000 basic annual salary, with first year on-target earnings of £48,500.
Based on hitting targets, you will also have the opportunity to increase your basic salary by £18,000 over the first three years of employment. This is in addition to the commission and incentives available through the role.
This is a role where hard work, consistency and strong performance are recognised. We want people who are motivated by targets, but who also understand the importance of booking genuine, high quality appointments for the wider sales team.
Benefits and incentives
We offer 32 days holiday including bank holidays, along with a strong package of short and long-term incentives.
This includes regular team nights out, performance based rewards, and staff trips abroad for those who achieve the right results.
You will be joining a business that is ambitious, fast moving and focused on growth, with a sales environment designed to reward people who perform well and take pride in their work.
What we are looking for
We are looking for people who are confident on the phone, positive in their approach, and resilient enough to handle the natural challenges of outbound sales.
Previous telemarketing, telesales, appointment setting or B2B sales experience would be useful, but the right attitude, work ethic and willingness to learn are just as important.
You should be comfortable speaking with business owners and senior decision makers, able to follow a clear sales process, and committed to booking appointments that give our field sales team a strong opportunity to help the customer.
About F One Technologies
We work with UK businesses to improve the way they communicate, connect and operate. Our services include cloud phone systems, internet connectivity, WiFi and networking, business mobile SIM plans, IT support, cybersecurity and wider business technology solutions.
We help customers to understand what they need, recommend the right solution, and provide ongoing support after installation. Our telemarketing team plays an important role in starting those conversations and introducing businesses to the areas where we can help.
Apply for the role
If you are confident, motivated and want a sales role with strong earning potential, we would like to hear from you.
Please send us your CV and a short message explaining why you feel this role would be a good fit.

Cloud Phone Systems.

Your phone system should make it easier for your team to communicate, collaborate and respond quickly, whether they are in the office, working remotely or out on site. We design, install and support modern cloud phone systems that bring together calling, video meetings, messaging and reporting across desk phones, mobiles and computers. We work with two carefully selected platforms, Elevate and Webex by Cisco, and recommend the right fit based on how your business operates, how your teams work together and the level of visibility you need, configuring and managing everything properly so it runs smoothly and reliably long term.

Get in touch

The Basics.

Traditional on site phone systems are replaced with a secure, fully cloud managed solution. You still benefit from all the core features businesses expect, such as call transfers, voicemail, hunt groups and intelligent call routing, without the need for bulky hardware or complex management.

Get in touch

Make the most of on-hold time by turning it into an opportunity to promote your services. With a wide choice of professional voice artists and soundtracks, you can create polished, engaging messages that showcase your brand.

No more wasted time scrolling through contacts. With our intuitive search-and-dial feature, finding and calling customers or suppliers takes just seconds — a simple but powerful tool that many phone systems miss.

Transfer calls to colleagues, teams, or external numbers in just a few clicks. Whether you’re on a desk phone, mobile, or PC app, it’s quick, simple, and seamless every time.

Never miss a message, voicemails go straight to your email with call details and audio attachments included. Prefer to read instead of listen? Switch on voicemail transcription for added convenience.

Take full control with our simple online portal. Manage call stats, directories, user access, and recordings all in one place. Update opening hours, choose the number your customers see, route calls by schedule, and make changes on the go, all with ease.

Work smarter with custom call routing, built around the way your team operates. We’ll tailor everything to keep your business running efficiently while giving your customers a smooth, professional experience.

item.title: Email Security
item.dc:creator: admin_getcrisp
item.content:encoded:
Email Security.

Acronis Email Security helps protect your inbox from phishing emails, malicious links, and impersonation attempts before they ever reach your team. It works directly with Microsoft 365 to stop email based threats at the point of delivery, helping reduce the risk of account compromise, data loss, and costly mistakes caused by unsafe emails.

Get in touch

Key Features.

Email remains the most common starting point for cyber attacks, and Acronis Email Security adds an extra layer of protection by analysing every message in real time rather than relying only on known threats. This helps stop suspicious emails before users interact with them, reducing the risk of human error and keeping everyday business communication secure.

Get in touch

Acronis Email Security identifies and blocks emails that attempt to impersonate trusted contacts such as suppliers, colleagues, or directors. This helps prevent payment fraud, fake invoice scams, and account takeovers by stopping convincing looking emails before users have a chance to respond.

All email attachments and links are scanned in depth, including files hidden inside other files. This allows threats to be detected even when they are deliberately disguised, helping prevent malware from reaching devices or spreading across the business.

The platform can detect previously unknown attacks by analysing how threats behave, not just whether they match known virus signatures. This helps protect against new and emerging threats that traditional email filtering may miss.

Acronis checks sender authenticity using technologies such as SPF, DKIM, and DMARC to help prevent spoofed emails and look alike domains. This reduces the risk of emails that appear legitimate but are designed to deceive users.

The service integrates directly with Microsoft 365 without disrupting how your team sends or receives email. Protection runs quietly in the background, adding security without adding complexity for users.

Central Security Dashboard.

Acronis provides a central dashboard that allows us to monitor email security activity in real time. This gives us clear visibility of blocked threats and emerging risks, allowing us to act quickly if anything unusual is detected, without you needing to manage another system.

item.title: CRN SMB Reseller of the Year 2022
item.dc:creator: lee_fonetech
item.content:encoded:
Since the start of F One, we never entered any of the various telecoms sector awards. Yes, this was partly because there are never enough hours in the day to put together an entry, but I would suggest that the main reason was that since the beginning of the company, our primary focus has been on getting our heads down and doing everything we can to simply establish a great business.

After working really hard with the GetCrisp team on our branding, website, social platforms, and so on throughout the end of 2021/beginning of 2022, it just felt like the right time to begin reaping the rewards of what had been sown over the previous 9 years. Not only that, but the products and services we now provide and maintain have had a genuinely positive impact on the way our customers work, so it felt like we actually had some really good case studies to present, rather than the usual run-of-the-mill nonsense that we assumed everyone else would put forward.

We decided to enter the CRN Channel Awards 2022 in the SMB Reseller of the Year category, once again, with the help of the fantastic GetCrisp team. We opted to submit a case study based on a solution we supplied to Zero Waste Group, a national waste removal firm. With the volume of calls Zero Waste were taking, they required an in depth call centre solution. For the most part, this was due to their complex call routing requirements. Their marketing strategy generates a huge volume of incoming calls, and in order to make their Google ad campaign spend worthwhile, they needed to catch every single missed call, something they were unable to achieve prior to our involvement.

Having analysed their needs, we recommended NEC’s Univerge Blue Contact Centre solution. This had all of the advanced call handling and routing features they needed, and lots more. But, it was in the missed call facility requirements that we went over and above their expectations. Most 'out of the box' missed call solutions require either a very manual process, or only return calls after a significant delay... by which time, potential customers of Zero Waste may have sought another waste removal company to complete the work. Together with NEC, our Technical Team developed a specific customisation to ensure that when a potential client decides that they don't want to wait, and hangs up, their place in the queue is kept automatically. By doing this, their customers not only received an automatic call back from one of the Zero Waste team, but most importantly they got that call back very quickly. This reduced their lost revenue significantly, and allowed to make the most out of their Google ads investment.

Once Zero Waste had completed their own internal analysis, they gleefully informed us that in the first month alone, 371 calls had been returned to potential customers… calls they would have ordinarily missed and lost. Based on a 15.2% call back to booking ratio, and an average booking value of around £330.00, they created more than £18,000.00 extra revenue in their first month, all thanks to our solution… absolutely incredible!

Whilst GetCrisp did an incredible job with the award entry, it still wasn’t something that I ever expected to win. I couldn’t help but think that we just didn’t stand a chance with all of the other, much larger telecoms providers that were in the running for the award. That said, and as most people that know me will tell you, I was wrong once again… WE WON!

It meant so much to Adam, Alex and I to win that award. Not because of the lovely trophy (which we are still waiting for by the way… nudge, nudge CRN Channel Awards guys), but because all of the blood, sweat and tears that have gone into making F One what it is today. I know it’s a cliché, but I wholeheartedly mean it when I say that we are so lucky to have such a great team that give their absolute all, day in and day out, not only for us but for our customers. Thanks once again to our incredible F One team… we couldn’t do it without you.

Needless to say, 2023 will see us enter more industry awards, wish us luck!

Lee New, Co-Founder & Sales Director

item.title: WLR Switch Off | The Facts
item.dc:creator: lee_fonetech
item.content:encoded:
Hi everyone!

Openreach have just announced that from 5th September 2023, WLR products (PSTN & ISDN digital phone lines) will no longer be sold in the UK. This will not only have a significant affect on businesses still using those traditional phone lines, but it'll also affect some companies using ADSL and/or FTTC broadband products.

We're constantly getting asked questions about the WLR switch off, so I thought I would share with you some information about it, as well as the benefits of cloud-based phone systems for businesses.

The WLR network has been the backbone of telephone communication for decades, but it is now aging and becoming more expensive to maintain. As a result, Openreach has decided to phase out the network in favour of newer technologies like VoIP and SIP.

If your business is still using analogue or digital phone lines, it is essential to start planning your move to the cloud right now. Here are some of the reasons why...

Cost Savings

One of the primary benefits of cloud-based phone systems is cost savings. Traditional phone systems require physical hardware and phone lines to be installed, which can be costly to set up and maintain. With a cloud-based phone system, all you need is an internet connection, which can be much cheaper than a traditional phone line.

In addition, cloud-based phone systems typically offer more predictable pricing models that are based on the number of users or features you need, making it easier to budget for phone services.

Flexibility and Scalability

Cloud-based phone systems offer greater flexibility and scalability than traditional phone systems. With a cloud-based phone system, you can easily add or remove users, features, and functionality as your business grows and changes. This makes it easy to adapt your phone system to meet your changing needs.

In addition, cloud-based phone systems are typically more customizable than traditional phone systems, allowing you to tailor the system to your specific business needs.

Remote Working Capabilities

Remote work has become increasingly popular in recent years, and the COVID-19 pandemic has only accelerated this trend. With a cloud-based phone system, remote work is easier than ever. Your employees can make and receive calls, video calls, and messages from anywhere with an internet connection.

This means that your business can continue to operate even if your employees are working from home or on the go. It also means that you can hire employees from anywhere in the world, increasing your pool of potential talent.

Easy to Use

Cloud-based phone systems are typically easier to use than traditional phone systems. With a cloud-based phone system, all of the features and functionality are accessible through a user-friendly online portal. This makes it easy for your employees to access the features they need and makes training new employees much easier.

In addition, cloud-based phone systems are typically more reliable than traditional phone systems, with fewer downtime issues and better disaster recovery options.

At F One Technologies Ltd, we understand that the switch to a cloud-based phone system can be daunting, especially for businesses that have been using the WLR network for years. That's why we offer a range of products and services designed to make the transition as smooth as possible.

We start by conducting a consultation to assess your business's needs and recommend the best phone system for you. We then handle the installation and configuration of the system, ensuring that everything is up and running smoothly. Finally, we offer ongoing support to ensure that your phone system is always working correctly.

In conclusion, the imminent WLR line switch off is a significant change that will impact many businesses in the UK. However, it is also an opportunity for businesses to embrace new technologies and enjoy the benefits that come with a cloud-based phone system.

If you have any questions or would like to learn more about our cloud-based phone solutions, please don't hesitate to get in touch with us on 0330 221 1183. We’re always happy to provide advice and guidance, whether you’re an F One customer or not.


Lee New, Co-Founder & Sales Director

item.title: Celebrating a Decade of Growth | Our 10 Year Journey
item.dc:creator: lee_fonetech
item.content:encoded:
This Sunday, 18th August 2024, marks a milestone for us at F One as we celebrate our 10-year anniversary. As I reflect on the incredible journey that has brought us here, I am filled with immense pride and gratitude for what we have accomplished together.

The past decade has been a whirlwind of challenges, triumphs, and significant growth. From our humble beginnings in a bedroom in Chandler’s Ford to becoming one of the UK’s leading telecoms providers, our journey has been nothing short of remarkable.

When we first envisioned F One, it was just a simple idea shared between Adam, Alex, and me. We had all worked together at Peach Technologies (now Tailor Made Technologies) and saw an opportunity to create something of our own. While we had the product knowledge and the drive, we were admittedly lacking in experience when it came to running a business. We were enthusiastic, perhaps a little naive, and convinced that we had it all figured out within just six months. I vividly remember us jokingly quoting Del Boy from Only Fools and Horses: “This time next year, we’ll be millionaires!”

Reality, however, had other plans. One of our earliest and most memorable lessons came when we realised we had completely overlooked the need to pay VAT. The bill, when it came, was more than we had in the bank... a shocking wake-up call and just one of many mistakes we made in those early days. But each mistake was a valuable lesson, shaping us not just as business owners but as individuals. Running a business turned out to be far more complex than we had imagined. The intricacies of finance, operations, and compliance were daunting, but those early challenges laid the foundation for the success we enjoy today.

Our first major contract with Faversham Ships was a turning point, and it wasn’t long before we moved into our first office... a converted barn on a farm in Titchfield. Looking back, it was a rustic setup with chickens wandering in and out, and space was rather tight. But it was exactly what we needed at the time. Those early days were all about building our reputation, securing the right partnerships, and gradually expanding our team.

From that barn, we moved to the Arena Business Centre in Segensworth, a significant step up. However, it wasn’t until we relocated to our current premises in St Mary’s Place, Southampton, that the business truly began to flourish. Having our own dedicated space allowed us to establish an identity that truly reflects who we are as a company. It’s a space that our team is proud to work in, and it has made a tremendous difference in our ability to attract and retain talent.

One of the achievements I’m most proud of is the growth of our team. We’ve evolved from a small, tight-knit group to a nearly 30-strong team of dedicated professionals. The loyalty and commitment shown by our team members is nothing short of remarkable. Many have been with us for years, helping to shape the company into what it is today, and their passion for the business is evident in everything they do. We’ve also had the pleasure of working with some amazing individuals who, although they’ve moved on, have left a lasting impact on our company. Their contributions have been instrumental in our growth, and I’m deeply grateful for the role they played in our journey.

As we’ve grown, we’ve gained a deeper understanding of what it takes to thrive in a constantly changing market. A crucial part of that has been our investment in social media outreach. Staying connected with our customers and the wider community is more important than ever, and our enhanced social media presence has allowed us to engage more effectively, share valuable insights, and keep everyone informed about the latest in technology. This effort hasn’t been without its drawbacks though... I still get plenty of ribbing from friends and family about my appearances in our social media videos, with some even dubbing me ‘David Brent’... I’m still trying to figure out why!

In addition to our digital efforts, we’ve focused on researching and offering the best products available. Our commitment to quality drives us to seek out innovative solutions that can truly benefit our customers. We’ve built strong relationships with industry-leading partners, enabling us to provide cutting-edge technology that meets the needs of today’s businesses.

We’ve also invested heavily in our customer-facing team. We believe that our customers deserve the highest level of service, which is why we’ve built a team that is not only knowledgeable and experienced but also deeply committed to providing exceptional support. This investment ensures that our customers receive personalised service that exceeds their expectations, whether they’re a small business with a handful of employees or a larger organisation with complex needs.

Like many businesses, we faced significant challenges during the COVID-19 pandemic. Our existing customer base, which still required reliable broadband, phone lines, and remote working solutions, helped us weather the storm. However, the pandemic did slow our growth as we were unable to reach new customers as effectively. Despite this, we’ve emerged stronger and more resilient, and I believe we’re now better positioned than ever to capitalise on new opportunities.

Over the past few years, we’ve seen substantial growth, with turnover increasing by 50% from February 2023 to February 2024. This growth has been driven by our expanding product portfolio, particularly in areas like business-grade WiFi, which has become increasingly important for our customers. We’ve also begun to explore IT services, a sector that I believe will play a significant role in our future.

Katie's unwavering commitment to her students is nothing short of remarkable.

Katie and her husband, Alex (our very own Co-Founder & Operations Director here at F One), are taking on one of the toughest physical challenges around: Tough Mudder. If you’re unfamiliar, it’s a brutal 10-mile race packed with 20 obstacles designed to push participants both physically and mentally. But what makes this challenge truly special is the mission driving it.

Katie's aiming to raise £2,000.00 for St Columba, a school that’s been on an extraordinary journey of transformation. In June, they achieved their first-ever 'Good’ rating from OFSTED, an incredible milestone that reflects the dedication and hard work of Katie and her fantastic team. Now, they’re looking to build on that success by providing new opportunities for their students, especially those that broaden their horizons and give them unique, once-in-a-lifetime experiences.

With school budgets tighter than ever, the money they raise will go directly toward projects that enrich the students' educational experiences. These aren’t just opportunities for academic growth, they’re life-enhancing experiences that the children will carry with them long after they leave primary school.

I know firsthand just how determined Katie is, and it’s no surprise she’s taking on this challenge. Not only to test her limits but to set an example for the children of St Columba. She’s showing them that with the right mindset and sheer determination, you can achieve anything.

Katie mentioned that training for Tough Mudder hasn’t exactly gone according to plan, but in true St Columba spirit, she’s pressing forward with the same dedication that helped transform the school. As Katie said herself, “I don’t give up on anything,” and I’m confident she’ll tackle this challenge with flying colours.

It’s not just about finishing the race, it’s about raising funds for a cause that will have a lasting impact on the children she cares so deeply about.

Rather than just reading about the features, we put the phones to work. item.title: A Real Example of Cyber Threats

item.content:encoded:
This week, something happened here at F One Technologies that really hit home how sophisticated cyber threats have become.

Logan Robertson, one of our Communications Specialists, received what looked like a genuine email from a prospective client complete with a PDF attachment. Thinking it was legitimate, he opened the file.

Within minutes, our cybersecurity systems detected over 5,000 login attempts from the US, all targeting his account.

The good news...

  • Our defences kicked in instantly.
  • The attack was stopped.
  • No data was compromised.

Logan was understandably upset and disappointed to think he might have let the team down. Like so many people in growing businesses, Logan is focused on providing great service and trusted advice, and this incident was a reminder that even the most careful among us can be caught off guard.

It was a great reminder that no one is immune to phishing even people who know what to look for. We used the incident as a chance to run extra training and strengthen our team’s awareness even further.

Cyber threats are constant, evolving, and can target any business big or small. The right defences and awareness make all the difference.

item.title: Meet the Directors, Three Wise(ish) Men
item.dc:creator: lee_fonetech
item.content:encoded:
It’s Christmas at F One, and we’re sitting down with the trio who built the business from the ground up: co-founders Adam, Alex and Lee, affectionately known this time of year as F One’s Three Kings. Since starting the company in 2014, the business has grown beyond expectations. Today, F One proudly supports 1,400 customers, 350 more than last year and turnover has climbed to £4.6 million, up £1.2 million in just 12 months.

Between them, they’re parents to seven children, long-time friends, and partners in both business and celebration. We ask all three, what they like most about F One, what they get up to when they’re not working and what they love about Christmas.


The Running King and Rum Connoisseur, Adam

Q: Adam, it’s a big year for you, two kids, a booming business, and a wedding to Geena this month. What do you love most about F One?

A: For me, it’s the mix of energy and loyalty. We’ve grown massively over the years, but we’ve kept the humour, pace and togetherness that got us off the ground. Everyone still pulls in the same direction and genuinely cares about doing things properly for our customers.

Q: And when you’re not steering the ship? 

A: Spending time with my two boys and my wife-to-be hopefully with a round of golf squeezed in. And watching Manchester United lose… it’s become a surprisingly reliable hobby.

Q: And Christmas, what’s the vibe?

A: I love the blend of calm and chaos. My side of the family is small and relaxed. Then there is my fiancées Irish Catholic clan where it feels like hundreds of people appear out of nowhere and the volume goes up by the minute. I genuinely love both, although I will admit the hangover after the Irish one is worse!


The Towering Tech King (Who’s Slightly Afraid of Heights), Alex

Q: Alex, at 6’4” you’re climbing the ladder of success but maybe not any others. What does F One mean to you?

A: F One feels like my third child. It gives me purpose every morning. I’m proud of the opportunities we create for our team and the difference we make to our customers’ businesses. It means a lot to be part of their success.

Q: What keeps you busy outside the office? 

A: My priorities are health, family, wealth and fun. I love sports but the gym is my real passion, it keeps the aches and pains at bay. Any time I’m not working or training, I’m with my wife and two children. And I treasure the friendships I’ve had for more than thirty years. That’s wealth to me.

Q: And Christmas, yay or bah humbug?  

A: Oh, I love everything about Christmas. And yes… I’ll admit it… the presents are still my favourite part. Maybe that makes me a little childish, but I’m OK with that!


The Comedy-Loving, Craft-Beer King, Lee

Q: Lee, football nut, dad of three daughters, British comedy fan tell us, what’s the best thing about F One?

A: It has to be the team. Eleven years in, so many of the people who helped us start are still with us today. They’re a huge part of what makes F One what it is. Even the newer team members just ‘get’ it. I wouldn’t swap them for any other.

Q: And when you escape the office? 

A: Padel. I’m basically one sponsorship deal away from Wimbledon calling. Wrong sport, I know… but you get the idea.

Q: And Christmas? 

A: Pigs in blankets. No question. Next.


Three founders, seven children, one thriving business and a shared festive spirit that keeps F One moving forward. 

From calm Christmases to chaotic ones, gym sessions to golf swings, padel courts to pigs in blankets these Three Kings continue to guide the company with humour, passion and heart.


From all of us at F One, Merry Christmas!

item.title: Smarter Communication For Estate Agents

At F One Technologies, I work closely with estate agencies and property management businesses who rely on fast, accurate communication to keep deals moving. That is why we partnered with RedCactus to deliver Bubble, a powerful integration that connects leading CRM platforms such as Street and Reapit directly with your cloud telephone system.

For estate agents, the CRM is the brain of the business. It holds everything. Landlords, tenants, applicants, property requirements, viewing history, notes, and next steps. Traditionally, phone systems have sat outside of that world, forcing agents to juggle screens, search for records mid call, or rely on memory.

Bubble removes that friction by tightly linking your phone system and CRM, so the right information is always in front of the agent at the right time.


What This Means Day To Day For Your Team

When a call comes into your business, whether an agent is working from the office, from home on a laptop, or purely from their mobile, the phone system checks the CRM in real time.

Before the agent even answers, they can see who is calling and key details pulled directly from the CRM, for example:

  • Is this a landlord, tenant, buyer, or applicant
  • Which properties they are linked to
  • What type of property they are looking for
  • Previous notes or recent activity

This removes the awkward “Can I just pull your details up?” moment and allows the agent to answer already informed.

Once the call is answered, the correct CRM record can automatically open on screen. There is no searching, no guesswork, and no risk of pulling up the wrong client during a busy period.

From my perspective, this is where the real value starts to show. Estate agents live in their CRM, but telephony has historically sat outside of it. Bubble brings those two worlds together. Agents can answer calls already knowing who they are speaking to and why they might be calling. That saves time, reduces mistakes, and creates a much more professional experience for the customer.

The same simplicity applies when agents make outbound calls. Instead of copying and pasting numbers, or typing them manually into a handset or mobile, agents can click a phone number directly inside the CRM. The phone system then places the call automatically.

  • The agent never has to leave the CRM. That means:
  • Faster call handling
  • Fewer dialling errors
  • More time spent speaking to customers rather than managing tools

For busy sales and lettings teams making dozens of calls each day, that difference quickly adds up.


Every Call Logged Automatically

One of the biggest challenges in estate agencies is keeping CRM records up to date, especially when teams are busy or working remotely. With Bubble, call activity can be automatically written back into the CRM, removing the reliance on manual note taking. This can include:

  • Time and date of the call
  • Call duration
  • Which agent handled the call

For agencies that want to go further, next generation AI can also transcribe and summarise calls. That summary can be published directly into the CRM, giving other team members a clear understanding of what was discussed and what the next steps are. The result is a complete communication history inside the CRM, so anyone picking up the relationship can instantly see where things stand.


Built Around How Estate Agents Actually Work

No two agencies operate in exactly the same way, which is why Bubble is designed to adapt to your workflows rather than force change. Using the Automations module, agencies can create simple rules such as:

  • Automatically opening the correct CRM screen when a call starts
  • Prompting agents with call scripts or reminders
  • Ensuring key actions are captured during busy periods

This helps standardise service levels, reduce admin, and ensure nothing slips through the cracks when call volumes are high.

Despite the power of the integration, setup is straightforward. While exact steps vary slightly depending on your CRM and phone system, the process is designed to be accessible to non technical users.

My team and I handle the guidance, configuration, and testing, ensuring a smooth rollout with minimal disruption to your day to day operations.

This integration is not about adding complexity. It is about making life easier for agents and ensuring customers get the right support quickly. When CRM and telephony work together, teams gain clarity, confidence, and efficiency on every call.

By bringing your phone system and CRM together, estate agencies gain better visibility, empower their teams, and deliver a more joined up customer experience.

item.title: New Cybersecurity Expectations – What It Means for Your Business
item.dc:creator: lee_fonetech
item.content:encoded:
By Adam Monaghan, Solutions Director, F One Technologies

Cybersecurity is no longer just an IT issue, it’s a fundamental part of running a responsible, resilient business.

Across the UK, organisations are increasingly expected to meet baseline security standards, particularly when working with larger enterprises, supply chains, or public sector contracts. Frameworks like Cyber Essentials, a government-backed scheme are becoming a standard requirement, helping businesses defend against common cyber threats.

For many small and medium-sized businesses, this shift can come as a surprise. What was once optional is quickly becoming essential to simply operate and compete.

What Cyber Essentials Really Means

At its core, Cyber Essentials focuses on a small set of practical, high-impact measures:

  • Securely configuring devices
  • Managing access to systems and data
  • Protecting against malware and cyber attacks
  • Keeping systems up to date
  • Securing networks and connections

These may sound straightforward, but they form the backbone of effective cybersecurity. Without them, businesses risk both operational disruption and compliance challenges.

Making Cybersecurity Achievable

Understanding your current position is often the hardest part. Many organisations benefit from starting with a simple review of their existing setup.

A structured approach helps to:

  • Identify vulnerabilities and gaps
  • Prioritise the most critical improvements
  • Create a clear path toward meeting Cyber Essentials standards

A More Connected Approach to IT Security

Modern cybersecurity is most effective when it works as a cohesive system. Today’s IT environments go beyond individual devices, encompassing users, data, and cloud platforms such as Microsoft 365.

With the right approach, businesses can achieve:

  • Centralised monitoring and management
  • Consistent protection across systems and devices
  • Secure handling of business data
  • Reliable, ongoing support

Simplifying Day-to-Day IT Management

Security is only one piece of the puzzle. Many businesses are also looking to simplify how they manage IT overall from licensing to user access.

Having a single, trusted point of contact for Microsoft 365 licensing, user management, security settings, and support can significantly reduce internal workload while improving efficiency and consistency.

Built-In Protection Where It Matters Most

A well-rounded cybersecurity setup typically includes:

  • Email Security: Protecting teams from phishing, malicious links, and impersonation attempts
  • Device Protection: Monitoring for unusual activity and defending against ransomware and viruses
  • Data Backup: Ensuring business-critical data can be quickly restored if needed

Staying One Step Ahead

While cyber threats continue to evolve, many attacks still exploit basic weaknesses. Strengthening these foundations goes a long way toward protecting your business and meeting growing compliance expectations.

If you’re unsure where your organisation stands, taking that first step, reviewing your current setup can provide valuable clarity and peace of mind.

item.title: Making Cyber Essentials Simple
item.dc:creator: lee_fonetech
item.content:encoded:
By Adam Monaghan, Solutions Director at F One Technologies

For many organisations, achieving Cyber Essentials certification has shifted from being a “nice to have” to a business necessity. Whether driven by customer expectations, insurance requirements, or eligibility for public sector contracts, certification is increasingly becoming part of the standard business landscape.

Yet despite its importance, many businesses still see Cyber Essentials as overly technical, time-consuming, or difficult to approach, particularly without dedicated in-house IT or security expertise.

At F One, we believe the process should be clear, practical, and manageable. That is exactly why we developed our Cyber Essentials Certification Support service: to help businesses achieve certification confidently, without unnecessary complexity.

Taking the Complexity Out of Certification

One of the biggest challenges organisations face is simply understanding where to begin. Technical terminology, security requirements, and compliance expectations can quickly feel overwhelming.

Our role is to simplify that journey.

Rather than flooding businesses with jargon or unrealistic technical demands, we focus on practical improvements that strengthen everyday cybersecurity while aligning with the Cyber Essentials standard.

The process starts with a Cyber Essentials Readiness Assessment, where we review your current IT environment against the certification requirements. This gives businesses a clear understanding of their current position, highlights any gaps, and identifies the steps needed before applying.

From there, we work collaboratively with your team to provide remediation and guidance support. That may involve improving security settings, reviewing policies, or advising on changes that bring systems into line with the required standards. Every recommendation is designed to be achievable, proportionate, and beneficial to the business long term.

We also support organisations throughout the application process itself, helping ensure submissions are completed accurately and confidently to minimise delays or unsuccessful outcomes.

More Than a Compliance Exercise

While many businesses initially pursue Cyber Essentials because it is required, one of the most valuable outcomes is the improvement it brings to day-to-day cybersecurity.

The controls introduced through certification are not simply box-ticking exercises they are practical measures that help reduce risk, strengthen resilience, and improve security awareness across the organisation.

“Cyber Essentials is often seen as a complicated technical process, but it does not need to be,” I often explain to customers. “Our role is to make the journey clear and manageable for businesses of all sizes, while helping them strengthen their overall security at the same time.”

For many organisations, the process also creates greater visibility into their wider IT and security posture, helping identify opportunities for improvement that extend well beyond certification alone.

Supporting Businesses Beyond Certification

Cybersecurity is not static, and certification should never be treated as a one-off task.

As businesses evolve, technologies change, and threats continue to develop, maintaining good security practices becomes increasingly important. That is why ongoing support matters just as much as the initial certification process.

At F One, we continue to work with organisations after certification has been achieved, helping them remain compliant, prepare for renewals, and maintain confidence in their security approach over time.

With the right support and clear guidance, Cyber Essentials certification can be far more straightforward than many businesses expect.

The key message is simple: you do not have to navigate the process alone.

item.title: Ryan Garner's Historic World Title Triumph at St Mary's Stadium
item.dc:creator: lee_fonetech
item.content:encoded:
By Lee New, Sales Director, F One Technologies

There are moments in sport that transcend the result itself, and Ryan Garner's remarkable victory at St Mary's Stadium was certainly one of them.

As someone who has followed Ryan's journey closely, I could not be prouder to see him achieve a lifelong ambition by becoming the WBC Interim Super Featherweight Champion in front of his hometown supporters. On behalf of everyone at F One Technologies, I would like to congratulate Ryan on an outstanding performance against Michael Magnesi in what was a truly unforgettable night for Southampton sport.

From the moment Ryan walked into a packed St Mary's Stadium, the atmosphere was incredible. More than 10,000 fans had come together to support one of Southampton's own, creating an occasion that felt special long before the opening bell rang.

Ryan rose to that occasion magnificently.

Over 12 hard-fought rounds, he delivered a disciplined, determined and highly professional performance against an experienced and respected opponent. Known as "The Piranha", Ryan set the tempo from the outset, taking the fight to Magnesi and repeatedly coming out on top during a series of intense exchanges.

When the final bell sounded, there was a sense throughout the stadium that we had witnessed something special. The judges confirmed that feeling, awarding Ryan a unanimous victory with scorecards of 116-112, 118-110 and 119-109.

The result not only secured the WBC Interim Super Featherweight Championship but also positioned Ryan as the number one contender for a future showdown with reigning WBC champion O'Shaquie Foster.

What impressed me most was not just Ryan's talent inside the ring, but the professionalism, resilience and determination he demonstrated throughout the entire journey. To see a local athlete realise a childhood dream in front of family, friends and thousands of hometown supporters was genuinely inspiring.

At F One Technologies, we have been honoured to support Ryan, and watching him deliver a world-class performance on the biggest stage of his career was a proud moment for everyone associated with our business.

Following the fight, Ryan spoke passionately about what the occasion meant to him, thanking Southampton FC, his supporters and everyone involved in bringing the event to life. It was clear that competing for a world title in Southampton was more than just another fight, it was the fulfilment of a dream.

While this victory marks a significant milestone, I have no doubt that Ryan's ambitions stretch even further. His sights are firmly set on the biggest opportunities in the division, and this latest achievement feels like the beginning of an exciting new chapter rather than the end of a journey.

Beyond Ryan's personal success, the event also showcased Southampton's ability to host major sporting occasions on a world-class scale. The city, the venue and the fans all played their part in creating a memorable night that will be talked about for years to come.

Congratulations once again, Ryan. Everyone at F One Technologies is immensely proud of what you have achieved, and we look forward to supporting you as you continue your pursuit of full world championship glory.

item.title: Next-Generation Connectivity: A Business Imperative, Not Just a Technology Upgrade
item.dc:creator: lee_fonetech
item.content:encoded:
For years, connectivity was viewed as a utility: something businesses needed to keep operations running but rarely considered a source of competitive advantage. Today, that mindset has changed dramatically.

As organisations navigate increasing demands for digital transformation, AI adoption, automation, hybrid working, and data-driven decision making, connectivity has become one of the most important strategic foundations of business success. The conversation is no longer about simply having a network. It is about whether that network can support the ambitions of the business both today and in the years ahead.

The arrival of next-generation connectivity technologies, including 5G, advanced fibre infrastructure, Wi-Fi 7, edge computing and increasingly intelligent network architectures, presents a significant opportunity for organisations willing to embrace change. However, it also raises an important challenge: how quickly should businesses move to adopt these technologies?

In my view, the organisations that begin planning and investing now will be the ones best positioned to lead tomorrow.

Connectivity Is Driving Business Innovation

Every major technology trend shaping the modern workplace relies on connectivity.

Artificial intelligence requires rapid access to data. Smart manufacturing depends on connected devices and real-time monitoring. Remote and hybrid workforces need secure, reliable access to applications and systems regardless of location. Customer expectations continue to rise as digital experiences become increasingly central to business success.

Without robust connectivity, many of these initiatives struggle to deliver their full potential.

What makes next-generation connectivity different is that it removes many of the limitations that businesses have historically faced. Lower latency, greater capacity, improved reliability and enhanced flexibility enable organisations to rethink how they operate, serve customers and create value.

This is not simply about faster speeds. It is about enabling new possibilities.

Competitive Advantage Will Belong to the Connected Enterprise

The organisations that thrive over the next decade are likely to be those that can adapt quickly, make better use of data and respond faster to changing market conditions.

Advanced connectivity supports all three.

Consider the role of real-time information. Whether managing supply chains, monitoring operational performance, supporting customer interactions or deploying AI-powered solutions, access to timely and accurate data has become a critical business asset.

The ability to collect, process and act upon information instantly can improve decision-making, reduce operational costs and create more agile organisations.

Businesses that continue to rely on legacy infrastructure may find themselves increasingly constrained as competitors leverage more advanced technologies and operating models.

Customer Expectations Continue to Evolve

The digital experience has become a defining factor in how customers perceive organisations.

Whether customers are accessing online services, engaging with support teams, participating in virtual consultations or consuming digital content, expectations around speed, responsiveness and reliability continue to increase.

Connectivity now plays a direct role in customer satisfaction, brand perception and loyalty.

The organisations that invest in modern connectivity infrastructure are often better positioned to deliver seamless experiences that customers increasingly expect as standard.

Preparing for an AI-Driven Future

Few technologies have captured business attention in recent years as much as artificial intelligence.

Yet many discussions around AI focus primarily on applications and outcomes while overlooking a critical dependency: network infrastructure.

AI systems generate, consume and analyse vast amounts of data. As organisations deploy more AI-powered tools, the demands placed on networks will continue to increase significantly.

Businesses that have already modernised their connectivity environments will be better equipped to scale these technologies effectively. Those that have not may discover that network limitations become a barrier to innovation.

This is one reason why connectivity planning should be an integral part of any AI strategy.

The Risk of Waiting Too Long

Every technology investment must be justified, and there is no universal timeline that applies to every organisation.

However, there is a growing risk associated with delaying action indefinitely.

Businesses that postpone connectivity modernisation may face higher future upgrade costs, increase operational inefficiencies, greater cybersecurity challenges and reduced flexibility when adopting emerging technologies.

More importantly, they may miss opportunities to innovate while competitors move ahead.

The pace of technological change shows no signs of slowing. Organisations that proactively prepare their infrastructure today are likely to enjoy greater agility and resilience tomorrow.

A Strategic Conversation for Business Leaders

The adoption of next-generation connectivity should not be viewed solely as an IT decision. It is a boardroom conversation.

Business leaders should be asking how connectivity can support growth objectives, improve operational performance, enhance customer experiences and enable future innovation.

The organisations that approach connectivity strategically are often the ones that unlock the greatest value from their wider digital transformation initiatives.

At F One Technologies, we work with organisations that recognise connectivity as a critical enabler of business success. While every organisation's requirements are different, one thing is becoming increasingly clear: next-generation connectivity is no longer a future consideration. It is a present-day business imperative.

The businesses that act now will be better prepared for whatever comes next.

By Adam Monaghan, Solutions Director, F One Technologies

item.title: The PSTN Switch-Off Is Six Months Away: Why Businesses Must Act Now
item.dc:creator: lee_fonetech
item.content:encoded:
By Adam Monaghan, Solutions Director, F One Technologies

The countdown to one of the biggest changes in UK business communications has entered its final phase.

On 31 January 2027, the UK's Public Switched Telephone Network (PSTN) will be permanently retired, bringing an end to the copper-based network that has supported telephone services for decades. While millions of homes and businesses have already migrated to modern digital services, Openreach estimates that around 1.5 million lines remain on the legacy network, including approximately 350,000 business locations.

To help accelerate the transition, Openreach has launched its Big Switch Off campaign, urging communications providers and businesses to take immediate action before the deadline arrives.

Why This Matters

The PSTN supports far more than traditional phone calls.

In my conversations with businesses across the UK, I regularly find organisations still relying on PSTN-connected devices and services such as:

  • Telephone systems
  • Card payment terminals
  • Lift emergency alarms
  • Security and monitoring systems
  • Door entry systems
  • Building management equipment
  • Other operational technologies

When the PSTN is switched off, any services still dependent on the network may stop functioning unless they have been upgraded or replaced with digital alternatives.

The Cost of Waiting

Businesses that postpone migration face several risks.

Operational disruption could affect customer service, productivity and business continuity. As we move closer to the deadline, demand for engineering support is expected to increase significantly, potentially making migrations more difficult to schedule.

There is also a growing financial incentive to move sooner rather than later. Openreach has introduced substantial increases to wholesale line rental pricing for legacy services, with a 40 per cent increase already implemented and a further 40 per cent rise scheduled. In many cases, moving to fibre-based connectivity and modern IP services can now provide a more cost-effective solution.

How We Can Help

At F One Technologies, we've been helping businesses modernise their communications and connectivity for years. My team and I can assess your existing infrastructure, identify any services that rely on the PSTN and develop a tailored migration plan that minimises disruption.

The switch-off deadline is fixed and there will be no extension. Businesses need to understand exactly which systems are still connected to the PSTN and make plans now to replace or upgrade them. The sooner organisations begin that process, the more options they'll have and the smoother the transition will be.

Many customers are surprised to discover that it's not just their phone system that could be affected. Payment terminals, alarm systems, lift lines and other critical services often depend on the PSTN. Our role is to identify those risks, recommend the right solutions and manage the migration from start to finish.

Preparing for a Digital Future

The retirement of the PSTN is part of the UK's wider digital transformation, replacing ageing infrastructure with modern IP-based services that deliver greater reliability, flexibility and performance.

From my perspective, this isn't simply about replacing old technology. It's an opportunity for businesses to improve resilience, support hybrid working, strengthen customer communications and take advantage of the latest cloud-based services.

Don't Leave It Too Late

With the PSTN switch-off now only months away, I would urge every organisation that has not yet reviewed its communications infrastructure to act immediately.

At F One Technologies, we can help you understand your exposure, identify affected services and create a clear roadmap to ensure your business is ready well before 31 January 2027.

If you'd like to discuss your PSTN migration strategy, please get in touch with our team today. The sooner you start planning, the easier and more cost-effective your transition is likely to be.
